§23.1 7 days notice before change takes effect; §23.2 continued use/close account; not explicit existing-account application.

Funded closure FAQ lists inactivity as breach and states 'simulated profit on it is void ... including profit earned before the breach'; inactivity FAQ requires one trade every 30 days in funded stage. Procedural missed activity can void all earned unpaid profits.

Max Exposure FAQ states rule set fixed at purchase 'for its whole lifetime, including after you progress to the next evaluation phase or to a funded account.' New challenges on/after Oct 13: first two warnings, third hard breach; 100/200k 2% exposure (pre-Aug 21 3%), smaller 3%, Instant 1% immediate hard breach.

§28.5 explicitly preserves statutory chargeback rights; multiple devices/IP allowed unless suspicious or associated with other users, region change subject to verification (travel proof).

EA FAQ requires prior approval even for trading assistants, prohibits automatic entries; 14h+ repeated trading, SL omission combined with other patterns can trigger review. Payout guide requires $100 net minimum, flat/no pending orders, account view-only during review, 14 days/7 add-on.
